startCommand: node --import tsx --input-type=module -e "import{Pool}from\"pg\";import{auditBuktiProduk}from\"./lib/audit-bukti-produk.ts\";const pool=new Pool({connectionString:process.env.DATABASE_URL,max:1});const q=await pool.query(\"SELECT id,name,images FROM products ORDER BY created_at\");async function* src(){for(const r of q.rows){let images;try{images=typeof r.images===\"string\"?JSON.parse(r.images):r.images}catch{images=r.images}yield{id:r.id,orgId:null,nama:null,images}}}const result=await auditBuktiProduk(src(),{simpanTerbrick:-1});console.log(JSON.stringify({schema:\"score80-l-legacy-audit/v1\",observed_at:new Date().toISOString(),exact_sha:process.env.RENDER_GIT_COMMIT||null,database_name:(await pool.query(\"SELECT current_database() n\")).rows[0].n,result,identity_fields_redacted:true,mutation:false}));await pool.end();"
